messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD-82714) — service=latency-alerts, symptom=p99 latency burn in us-west, 14 alerts in last 5m.

tom_oncall: acked. I'm oncall — Tom. Starting triage.

ashley_sre: quick glance — p99 for /v1/generate in us-west ~6.2s (baseline ~0.9s). CPU OK, but KV cache evictions spiked and batching latency increased. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/dash?panel=us-west-latency

ashley_sre: relevant query used:
```
sum(rate(requests_total{route="/v1/generate",region="us-west"}[2m])) by (model)
```
shows a 3x burst to model-x-small; correlation with cache evictions: `kv_cache.evictions{region="us-west"}` up 4x.

maya: can we short-circuit to model-x-small-approx (lower mem, faster) or route noisy customers to burst pool? Also consider increasing replicas while we investigate.

ashley_sre: preparing mitigation: will scale inference-sidecar and start a cache-warm job.

tom_oncall: scaling now — `kubectl scale deploy inference-sidecar-usw --replicas=24` (was 12).

mike_sre: launched cache warm replay job: `opsctl jobs run cache-warm --target /v1/generate --qps 500 --region us-west` (started).

ashley_sre: bumped per-route concurrency cap to reduce head-of-line delays: `opsctl set config route:/v1/generate concurrency=500` (applied).

tom_oncall: also temporarily disabled heavy canary rollout for model-x on us-west: flipped routing weight 70/30 -> 95/5 to fallback variant.

ashley_sre: after scale + warmup, p99 dropped to ~1.4s within ~2m. Monitoring continues. :thumbsup:

joni_cs: CS update — two enterprise customers reported slow pagination/autocomplete but no errors. They've been notified we are investigating.

tom_oncall: good. tagging customer-impact: partial increased latency, not availability. Will keep PD open for 30 more minutes and monitor.

maya: taking primary monitoring for next shift. Handoff summary: traffic burst to model-x-small causing KV churn, mitigations: scaled replicas, cache warm, concurrency bump, rollback canary weight. Links: grafana (latency + cache), Kibana logs, runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/latency-p99. If p99 > 3s re-open PD and escalate to infra.

tom_oncall: noted. I'll create an incident ticket (INC-2026-145) with timeline + commands used. Leaving the channel to maya.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note — PD-82714 acknowledged by tom_oncall, status=acknowledged -> resolved by manual close after monitoring.

maya: monitoring OK at T+25m, p99 stable ~1.2s. Will keep eyes on it for 1h and then mark resolved in the runbook. Thanks team.

ashley_sre: follow-up: need a postmortem on routing policy + autoscaler thresholds to avoid future KV thrash. Filing a GH issue.

tom_oncall: thanks all, closing chat after handoff.
